title: Super Cup ATTP – Autumn 2024: Stage I registration
excerpt: Super Cup ATTP – Autumn 2024: Stage I registration
body_html:
Registration of players for the national table tennis tournament Super Cup ATTP - AUTUMN 2024 (29 November – 1 December 2024 / Top Cup Academy - Chișinău) has closed.

Let’s cheer on our players, who show their talent and determination every time!

We wish the participants to put all their skill, resources and sporting potential into achieving outstanding results at this grand tournament.

May optimism and the will to win always be with them and drive them to be the best.
